dealer.actions.help: One next action per item, based on current stored records and the demo date. Signing blockers come first. This is not a replay of historical stock or a collection tracker.
dealer.actions.empty: No items need attention for these checks on this demo date.
dealer.actions.reason.awaiting_signer: A saved company application is waiting for an authorised signer.
dealer.actions.reason.prepare_item: Returned item: confirm the required work and a new valuation before publishing its next offer.
dealer.actions.reason.offer_ready: The published next-lease offer is ready. A new application, approval and agreement are still required.
dealer.actions.signatures: Saved offers waiting for an authorised signer: {count}.
dealer.actions.signingNext: Ask the applicant to follow up with their authorised company signer. The offer remains unsigned and inactive; additional application checks may still apply.
dealer.actions.signingLimit: This demo records the handoff but does not send emails, provide delegated signing or let the dealer approve the application. Customer answers and contact addresses are not shown here.
match.baselineCorrectionHelp: This correction is a preview until you use a matching plan and publish it. It does not change earlier contracts or invoices.
match.correctBaseline: Correct the original date or price using verified information
match.baselineReason: Source and reason for this correction (10–500 characters)
match.baselineMissing: No original price reference is available. Enter verified information with an explanation to compare.
match.baseline.imported_assumption: Demo assumption: first use is 1 January of the model year; original net price comes from price list v1. These are approved assumptions, not verified history.
match.baseline.recorded_lease: Original date and net price come from the first recorded lease. Later leases preserve this reference.
match.baseline.operator_verified: The operator supplied corrected original facts and recorded their source. This remains a synthetic operator step.
match.baseline.operator_assumption: Saved operator-supplied demo assumptions; these are not verified first-lease facts.
match.overrideHelp: The recommendation follows deadline and repair-cost priority. You may choose another eligible customer or condition, with a reason saved in the audit trail. Eligibility checks still apply.
match.overrideReason: Why choose this plan instead? (10–500 characters)

wait.loadFailed: Waiting requests could not be loaded. Retry to continue.
wait.categoryScope: Pending requests are for any suitable item in this category, rather than the specific item on this page. If an item is reserved for you, its link appears below.
wait.help: Choose what you need and your maximum monthly rent before VAT. This request belongs to the selected demo customer. Joining does not reserve an item or approve a lease.
wait.alreadyPending: You already have a pending request in this category. Use Edit request below to update your preferences.
wait.summary: Up to {budget}/month before VAT · Needed by {date}
wait.allocated: Item reserved — application and approval still required
wait.importedHelp: Sample requests use team-created demo customer links, except wait-01, which remains anonymous. Anonymous requests can be recommended but cannot reserve an item. Requests created in Customer mode belong to the selected demo customer.
wait.autoLinked: This customer joined the waiting list themselves. Publishing reserves the item for them; they still need a new application and approval.
spine.error.WAITING_INPUT_INVALID: Choose a supported term and a deadline on or after the demo date, with a positive monthly budget.

match.title: Find the next lease
match.assumptions: Age is calculated in whole months on the expected ready date. The original date and price reference are preserved across lives; any correction needs its source and reason.
match.policy: Feasible offers use estimated market value after repair, zero down payment and the requested term. Priority: earliest deadline, lowest repair cost, then request ID for exact ties.
match.readinessHelp: Use the plan on its ready date, then confirm each completed repair below. A preview does not record completed work.
match.noMatch: No feasible match yet. Review the reasons below.
match.compare: Compare repair plans and waiting requests
match.tableHelp: All amounts are net euros. Recovery = estimated market value minus repair cost; it is not accounting profit. Repairs are estimates until confirmed.
match.error: Could not load matches. Check the inputs and try again.
match.valuationReason: Matched {request} using the original valuation reference and age of {age} months; estimated post-repair market value.
match.selected: Selected {request}. Confirm the completed work before publishing and reserving.
spine.error.MATCH_CHANGED: The match, readiness date or reservation changed. Refresh and review the recommendation again.

spine.dateHelp: Changing this date simulates a different day. Saved documents keep their own dates.
spine.error: We could not complete this action. Your saved records have not been replaced. Try again.
spine.downHelp: This reduces the amount financed. It is not a refundable deposit. VAT is added when the invoice is issued.
spine.rentTotal: Rent over the full term before VAT
spine.ownTotal: Upfront payment + rent + optional purchase before VAT
spine.buyout: Optional purchase at the end before VAT

spine.factorDetail: Financed amount × coefficient {factor}. Financing band {band}. Each monthly net amount is rounded to one cent.
spine.bandHelp: More upfront payment can move you to another financing band. It does not always reduce the monthly rent.
spine.quoteSaved: Offer saved. Valid through {date}. Review these saved amounts before signing.
spine.unavailable: This item is not currently available for a new lease.
spine.invalidTerms: These terms cannot be financed. Check the upfront payment and lease term.
spine.reviewHelp: Check the item, saved price, dates and answers. You can edit your answers and submit them again.
spine.approved: Your application is approved for these terms.
spine.declined: We cannot offer this lease based on the current information.
spine.manual_review: A person needs to check this application. Signing is not available.
spine.signatory.state: The contract is unsigned and the lease is not active.
spine.signatory.next: Ask this person to review the saved offer and arrange the company’s signature.
spine.signatory.demoLimit: This demo saves the contact details. It does not send an email or support signing as this person.
spine.incomplete: We need more information before making a decision.
spine.fixHeading: Complete or correct these answers, then check the application again:
spine.nextApproved: Review the saved terms below before you agree and start this demo lease.
spine.nextDeclined: No agreement has been created. You can try different terms or another item.
spine.nextManual: This demo cannot complete a manual review. If an answer is wrong, correct it and check the application again.
spine.consent: I have checked these saved terms and understand the upfront payment, invoices and end choices.
spine.sign: Agree and start this demo lease
spine.passed_on: Passed on for a new lease
spine.forecastHelp: This is a forecast using the current tax data. It is not an issued invoice. Late invoices use the date they are actually issued in the demo.
spine.issue: Issue invoices due by the selected demo date
spine.nextDate: Move demo date to the next scheduled invoice
spine.noneIssued: No invoices have been issued yet.
spine.issuedHelp: Issued does not mean paid. This demo does not collect payments.
spine.endHelp: At the end of the term you can buy, return or pass the item to another person through a new lease. Early exit is outside this basic flow.
spine.endNotReadyDate: End choices are available on or after {date}, once all monthly invoices have been issued.
spine.endInvoiceProgress: {issued} of {total} scheduled monthly invoices have been issued.
spine.maturity: Move demo date to the end of the term
spine.endConsent: I understand that this closes the current lease. Passing on requires a separate application and agreement.
spine.relist: Prepare the item for its next lease
spine.operatorHelp: Record the required work, a new net valuation and its reason. These controls simulate an operator; they are not a login or a certification.
spine.lastService: Usage reading at the last service
spine.workDone: Required work completed in this demo
spine.publish: Record the work and publish the new offer
spine.historyHelp: This history shows recorded item events. Earlier leases reported in the original data have no detailed records here.

spine.why.q_customer_type: We use this to choose the questions and rules for the person or business leasing the item.
spine.why.q_birth_date: Age is checked on the lease start date. You must be at least 18.
spine.why.q_email: This is the contact address for the agreement and invoices.
spine.why.q_country: The demo's residency rule accepts Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
spine.why.q_employment: This gives context for checking whether the rent fits your budget.
spine.why.q_monthly_income: The demo limits an individual's monthly rent including VAT to 30% of monthly net income.
spine.why.q_business_id: Identifies the business in the agreement. The demo checks the ID's format and check digit.
spine.why.q_company_name: This name appears on the agreement and invoices.
spine.why.q_can_sign: The person agreeing on the company's behalf needs authority to sign.
spine.why.q_signatory_email: Identifies the person who should review and sign for the company.
spine.why.q_vat_registered: Changes how prices are presented, with or without VAT. It does not remove VAT from invoices.
spine.why.q_usage_purpose: Delivery work can cause more wear and helps us plan the return inspection.
spine.why.q_farm_registry: Farm machines in this demo are for registered farms or contractors.
spine.why.q_annual_revenue: The demo asks for this when company financing is EUR 50,000 or more.
spine.why.q_beneficial_owners: The application rules ask who owns more than 25% of the company.
spine.why.q_pep: This question is asked for financing of EUR 10,000 or more. A yes answer requires a person's review.
spine.why.q_pep_details: These details help a person review a politically exposed person's application.
spine.reason.under_age: You must be at least 18 on the lease start date.
spine.reason.residency: This demo offers leases to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
spine.reason.unaffordable: The monthly rent including VAT is more than 30% of monthly net income. Choose different terms or an item with a lower price.

spine.reason.pep: A politically exposed person's application needs review by a person.

explain.title: Your price, explained
explain.fixedNet: {amount} before VAT each month. This amount is fixed when you sign.
explain.upfrontTiming: Upfront invoice estimated for {date}. Monthly rent is separate.
explain.buyoutTiming: Optional, at the end on {date}. You can return the item instead.
explain.ownEquation: Total to use {use} + optional end purchase {buyout}.
explain.financedHelp: The item price minus the upfront payment. This is used to calculate rent; you do not pay it again.
explain.factorHelp: This monthly multiplier includes financing costs. It comes from band {band} in coefficient table {version}. It is not an annual interest rate.
explain.rounding: Each monthly rent and its VAT are rounded to the nearest cent, with half a cent rounded up. Totals add those rounded payments.
explain.rentTerm: {count} monthly payments. The lease ends on {date}.
explain.timelineHelp: Your rent before VAT stays fixed. Each invoice uses the VAT rate on its issue date.
explain.assumptions: Estimates assume the upfront invoice on {upfront}, monthly invoices on their scheduled dates, and optional purchase on {end}. They use the supplied VAT rates; changes to tax rates or invoice dates can change what you pay.
explain.invalidAmount: Enter an amount in EUR with no more than two decimal places, for example 100 or 100.50.
explain.invalidDown: Enter an upfront payment from zero to {maximum}, with no more than two decimal places.
explain.belowMinimum: Keep at least {minimum} financed. Reduce the upfront payment or choose another item.
explain.aboveMaximum: Finance no more than {maximum}. Increase the upfront payment or choose another item.
explain.invalidStart: Choose a start date on or after {date} that allows the full lease term to finish.
explain.unknownTerm: This term is not available for the financed amount. Choose another term.
explain.noVat: The tax data does not cover every payment date. We cannot show a reliable total for these dates.
explain.tableNotValid: The financing table is not yet valid on this demo date. Choose a date on or after {date}.
explain.saveHelp: This saves a price offer and opens the application. It does not reserve the item or start a lease.
explain.firstMonthHelp: The first monthly rent is scheduled for the start date, even when you also make an upfront payment.
explain.compareHelp: Same item, upfront payment and start date. A lower monthly payment can mean a higher total cost.
explain.comparisonHelp: Choosing a term updates your estimate. Save your terms when you are ready to continue to the application.
explain.comparisonTiming: The first monthly payment is scheduled for {date}. Totals add all scheduled payments using the supplied VAT rates.
explain.bandChanged: Financing {fromAmount} uses band {fromBand} and coefficient {fromFactor}. With {toAmount} financed, band {toBand} applies with coefficient {toFactor}.
explain.bandInfoSummary: Why more upfront may change the monthly rent
explain.bandReference: Compared with no upfront payment for the same lease term:
explain.bandHigher: With this upfront payment, the monthly rent before VAT is {amount} higher.
explain.bandLower: With this upfront payment, the monthly rent before VAT is {amount} lower.
explain.bandSameAmount: The rounded monthly rent before VAT is unchanged.
explain.invalidBusinessDate: Choose a valid demo date before calculating a price.
explain.savedBasis: These are the net prices saved on {date}. Catalogue price changes do not replace this offer while it is valid.
match.anonymousPreview: Anonymous request: recommendation only; a known customer is required before reservation.
match.estimateExplanation: Estimated repair cost: {cost}. Earlier deadlines win, then lower repair costs; request ID breaks remaining ties.
